data.name: Greater Mutagen
data.description: The mutagenic mauler's mutagen now grants a +4 natural armor bonus, a +6 alchemical bonus to one physical ability score (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution), and a +4 alchemical bonus to a second physical ability score. The mutagenic mauler takes a -2 penalty on both associated mental ability scores as long as the mutagen persists.
